  Beverly Hills City Council Liaison I Wallis Annenberg Committee Meeting

  MEETING HIGHLIGHTS
  Wednesday, May 16, 2018
  4:00 PM

  MEETING CALLED TO ORDER
  Date/Time:  May 16, 2018 /4:05 PM

  IN ATTENDANCE:  Mayor Julian Gold, Councilmember Lili Bosse, City Manager Mahdi Aluzri,
  Chief of Police Sandra Spagnoli, Assistant Director Public Works Chad
  Lynn, Senior Management Analyst Logan Phillippo, Executive Assistant I
  Beverly Turner, Wallis Annenberg Center for the Performing Arts
  Managing Director Rachel Fine, Wallis Annenberg Center of Performing
  Arts Board Member MeraLee Goldman

  1) Public Comment
  Members of the public were given the opportunity to directly address the Committee on any
  item listed on the listed on the agenda.

  Speakers: None

  2) Facilities I Maintenance
  • City Manager Mahdi Aluzri and Assistant Director Public Works Chad Lynn discussed
  various details of the Wallis Annenberg budget and addressed possible terms’ under
  which the City might accommodate the Wallis Annenberg Center for Performing Arts
  request for funding.
  • Mayor Julian Gold, Councilmember Lili Bosse, and City Manager Mahdi Aluzri
  recommended to Rachael Fine and MeraLee Goldman that they attend June 5, 2018
  Study Session where the Wallis Annenberg budget will be included as part of citywide
  budget discussions.

  3) Campus Security:
  • City Manager Mahdi Aluzri indicated that the City would continue to assist in developing a
  security plan for Wallis Annen berg Center for Performing Arts.
  • Chief of Police Sandra Spagnoli presented options for security enhancements including
  equipment and additional staff time with an initial cost of approximately $55,000, and a
  recurring cost of $150,000.
 Beverly Hills City Council Liaison I Wallis Annenberg Center of Performing Arts Committee
May 16, 2018
Meeting Highlights

  •  Councilmember Liii Bosse raised issues of security check procedures and the use of metal
  detectors. Mayor Julian Gold suggested any security check system would have to be
  branded for the lobby in a way that is unique to Wailis Annenberg Center.
  •  Mayor Julian Gold asked Chief Spagnoli to look into facial recognition technology options.
  •  Chief Spagnoli also recommended that the Wallis Annenberg hire a Security Risk
  Manager to access security issues.

ADJOURNMENT
Date/Time:  May 16, 2018/4:55 PM
